- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:213-215 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: If the claude-implement.unavailable marker write fails after Codex edits transfer, the script only warns and continues, so implement_commit_changes.sh (lines 317-321) commits the Codex edits as claude-bot.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: MAJOR from three reviewers. Sonnet and gemini also raised the diagnosability aspect separately as NIT.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:21-26,213-215 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The marker write redirects stderr to /dev/null, so the marker_write_failed warning carries no cause (path/detail).
  WHY: Operators cannot diagnose permissions, disk-full or stray-file failures. Severity disagreement: NIT from most reviewers, MAJOR from minimax_minimax-m3. Highest is stated in the next entry.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:21-26 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `&&` chain in heal_mark_claude_unavailable allegedly masks a partial failure (mkdir succeeded, marker file creation failed), so the function returns 0 and no warning prints.
  WHY: The commit is then mislabeled claude-bot silently; the reviewer rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:273-279,2108-2317 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_EDITOR_ENGINE_FELL_BACK=false is reset only on Claude success, and the retry loop does not reset the worktree, so a Claude retry after an OpenCode attempt can leave a mixed workspace committed as claude-bot.
  WHY: It misattributes OpenCode edits to the Claude engine.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28881 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The poller's AI_COMMIT_IDENTITY log line (role=RB_JUDGE scope=poller) omits the `engine=` field.
  WHY: Log analysis keyed on `engine=` sees nothing for the poller path. Also reported as a task gap.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
